title: Corporate Boardroom at Dusk
purpose: Enterprise sector card and corporate-governance surfaces.
story: A corporate boardroom at dusk above a darkening skyline — the height of private authority, calm before the night's decisions.
environment: A high-floor boardroom, a long table set against floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking a city at blue hour.
architecture: Restrained modern interior — a clean coffered ceiling, full-height glazing, stone-clad end walls receding into shadow.
composition: The table on the central axis silhouetted against the blue-hour skyline, one warm lamp anchoring the foreground, deep negative space at the glass.
objects: a city skyline beyond the glass
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; the skyline reads cool while one warm lamp holds the accent.
